authorized_scope: One push-triggered GET-only readback of original A23 run/job/check/annotations/artifact metadata and the fixed 580-byte failed aggregate ZIP; no measurement or original-study change.
reviewed_controls: Single fixed push branch audit/p8-scale-100k-terminal-28fe-20261009; run_attempt==1 required after first receipt.
One ubuntu-24.04 job with 5 minute limit and actions/checks/contents read permissions.
No checkout, subprocess, exec/eval, native artifact execution, measurement or retry.
Five fixed GitHub GET endpoints; 30 second request timeout, 16 MiB cap, strict UTF-8, raw bytes saved and printed before status interpretation.
Exact run/job/check source identity; complete annotations count and artifacts single-page count required, not silently truncated.

Bearer confined to fixed api.github.com requests; redirects disabled. Artifact API must return 302 to HTTPS *.blob.core.windows.net without username/password; fresh storage request has no Authorization and no redirect.
Exact official artifact ID, size and digest plus downloaded 580-byte SHA verified before ZIP parsing.
ZIP only read in memory, never extracted; exactly one non-directory JSON basename, bounded declared size and ZipFile CRC validation; original ZIP/base64 and JSON bytes retained.
Original aggregate status failed and passed=false expressly required. Readback passed=true never reclassifies original measurement success.
Exceptions record non-success; always upload preserves accumulated original responses and receipt. API transport/identity failures may stop subsequent reads and must remain visible.
boundary: This is static review only. No local AST parse, syntax execution or workflow execution was performed because the local backend was unavailable.
The reader does not validate full scale samples or grant TODO closure.
No general adversarial archive acceptance is asserted; ZIP trust is constrained by exact known ID/size/SHA and data-only parsing.
Approval covers only the frozen V2 blob. V1 remains unreferenced historical preparation.
